candidates.source_description: One of the GREATEST moments in NFL history, and one of the most ICONIC calls in sports broadcasting history. On January 14, 2018, the Minnesota Vikings faced the New Orleans Saints in the NFC Divisional Round of the NFL Playoffs, producing one of the most unforgettable finishes football has ever witnessed.
